notes.title: Update 0.18.0 - Rhythm Experiment
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44715002/89afa4f406adff9abe81faef82a86559b637b745.png[/img]

[b]With the newest update, we are releasing the first task that is outside the typical aim training area.[/b]

[b]New Task: Rhythm Click[/b]
- In this task, you’ll aim at targets arranged in a fixed grid, following the rhythm of a metronome, meaning it relies heavily on sound cues. If you hit a target within the timing window of the beat, your level will increase.

[i]Metronomes are often used in sports to improve speed and coordination. We’re applying the same concept to help you move faster. The metronome’s speed adjusts to match your skill level and is set just a bit faster than your current speed, encouraging you to improve your speed over time.[/i]

- Added an option to play only the metronome sound while in Rhythm Click

This task is only available in the training section in the [b]Experimental Training[/b] and doesn´t affect your overall skill level for now.

Let us know what you think of the experimental approach in our [url=discord.aimcademy.gg]discord server[/url], as well as any desired changes or ideas.

[i]If you like the update and Aimcademy overall, we would greatly appreciate your review on our [url=play.aimcademy.gg]Steam page.[/url][/i]

[b]Developer suggestion:[/b] Try it with a low sense—it’s a great warm-up for your shoulder! :)

notes.title: Update 0.15.0 - Playlist and Balancing
notes.content:
[i][b]Introducing the First Playlist, Changes to Skill Levels, and Task Adaptations[/b][/i]

[i][b]We've heard you![/b][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44715002/da0d7e31a6df340529272e7f3fd8174e527e8f2c.png[/img]

[i]Here are the highlights of this update:[/i]

[b]Playlist[/b]
- Playlist: Play a series of personalized game modes back to back
- Endscreen: Captures the results of the playlist all at once

[b]Balancing[/b]
- Your skill level now reflects your best repetition from the past few days, instead of just the last repetition.
--> [i]No more worrying about lowering your rank by playing slightly worse[/i]

- These scores represent your current skill, meaning they gradually decrease after 60 hours
--> [i]Consistency is KING[/i]

- The global top percent stat now considers score expiration—you need at least one score in the last 4 weeks for that specific game mode 
--> [i]No more ghost players[/i]

[b]All Personalized Modes:[/b]
- Updated result view
- Skill level and reaction time data have been reset due to balance changes
- Reduced skill level easing at the start of a session, so you start closer to your latest result
- Changed skill level calculation to factor in both the final and average score of each repetition
--> [i]MAKE EVERY SECOND COUNT[/i]

[b]Cluster Click Changes:[/b]
- Moved clusters upward so targets no longer spawn in front of the white line on the ground
- Lowered time pressure in Cluster Click
- Updated the design of the radial progress bar

[b]Flick Training Changes:[/b]
- Reduced the target spawn area
- Lowered the consecutive hits needed to level up, [i]making it more responsive[/i]
- Added an option to skip the reaction time test and use a fixed reaction time

The full update notes can be found in the in-game changelog.
[hr][/hr]
Thanks to our awesome community! Your feedback and feature requests are greatly appreciated. Special thanks go to [b]00Twitchy[/b], [b]shyy[/b], [b]Training[/b], [b]Avatix Nathan[/b] , [b]RyZEX[/b] and [b]!x6ije[/b] for their contributions.

If you want to request new features, or want to share your feedback, let us know on our [url=discord.aimcademy.gg]discord server[/url].

[i]If you like the update and Aimcademy overall, we would greatly appreciate your review on our [url=play.aimcademy.gg]Steam page.[/url][/i]

notes.content:
[i]We wouldn’t consider this a hotfix, but at least a [b]lukewarm update[/b], addressing small bugs and feature requests.[/i]

[b]Added[/b]
- Added additional keybind to interact with 'Space'
- Added keybind to quick restart game session with 'R'
- Added controls info in 'click to start'-screen before each game mode

[b]Changed[/b]
- Increased the time required before the skill level is decreased automatically when not playing
- Updated FOV label in options menu to indicate that it is based on the vertical angle

[b]Fixed[/b]
- Fixed an issue in challenge mode displaying a personal best when none was achieved
- Fixed a bug where the last page of the global leaderboard was empty with a certain number of entries 


[i]If you want to request new features, or want to share your feedback, let us know on our [url=discord.aimcademy.gg]discord server[/url].[/i]

notes.title: Update 0.13.0 - New Challenge
notes.content:
[i]It´s time for a [b]new Challenge[/b], an additional [b]Leaderboard[/b] for the Overall Skill level, [b]Ranks[/b] and much more.[/i]

Here are the highlights of this update:

[b]New Challenge:[/b]
- [b]Just 5:[/b] You have only 5 seconds to clear each stage. [i]How far can you make it?[/i]

[b]Added:[/b]
- Global leaderboard for Overall skill level
- Colored indicator on training buttons in main menu to show the current level
- Option to toggle the mouse sensitivity menu before each training session
- Rank badges and an additional view in the main menu

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44715002/ce7419bc6253bd123063e324a1cf321f12f0e4cb.png[/img]

[b]Changed:[/b]
- Balancing change for "React Track"
- Target spawn location in "Switch Training" changed from grid position, to random positions
- Exchanged the old Track Challenge with "Just 5"

[i]We want to focus on one primary challenge at a time. In the future, we will introduce secondary rotating challenges.[/i]

[b]More in the in-game changelog[/b]

If you want to request new features, or want to share your feedback, let us know on our [url=discord.aimcademy.gg]discord server[/url].

[i]If you like the update and Aimcademy overall, we would greatly appreciate your review on our [url=play.aimcademy.gg]Steam page.[/url][/i]

- Rank badges and an additional view in the main menu

notes.title: Update 0.12.0
notes.content:
[i]Not only do we have a new task and features, but we've also made a variety of improvements thanks to the feedback from our community.[/i]

Here are the highlights of this update:

[b]New personalized game mode:[/b] 
- [i][b]React Track[/b][/i] featuring a twitchy, in-game-like, fast moving, jumping and crouching target.

[b]Added[/b]
- More accurate mouse sensitivity values (up to thousands)
- It is now possible to enter exact sensitivity values by clicking directly onto the sensitivity value
- Added game sensitivity presets to options menu
- Added label to show current skill level for game mode when hovering over it in main menu
- Added option to turn off performance feedback (the floating + and - signs in game)

[b]More in the in-game changelog[/b]

Thank you for your feedback, if you want other features, let us know on our [url=https://discord.aimcademy.gg/]discord server[/url]. 

[i]If you like the update and Aimcademy overall, we would greatly appreciate your [b]review on Steam[/b].[/i]
